name: review-hub-vscode
description: Review AI changes proposed through MCP and accept or reject individual hunks. Works with Claude Code, opencode, dsh, Cline and Roo.
author: Hung, Tong Duy Dat

review-hub.enabled.description: Enable Review Hub. When off, the hub server is not started and the file watcher is disabled.

review-hub.watchDirectWrites.deprecationMessage: Review Hub now reviews MCP proposals only. Filesystem and Git diffs are ignored.
review-hub.watchDirectWrites.description: Deprecated. Direct file writes do not create Review Hub reviews.

review-hub.autoOpenDiff.description: Automatically open MCP changes as an inline red/green review in the native editor. Each hunk has Accept/Reject actions; Auto Save continues to save only the real file.

review-hub.ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore whitespace-only changes when computing hunks.

review-hub.maxFileSize.description: Skip hunk-level diffing for files larger than this many bytes (whole-file accept/reject only).

review-hub.excludeGlobs.description: Extra glob patterns ignored by the watcher and snapshot. Built-in defaults (VCS, deps, caches, ML/data artifacts) always apply; entries here are added to them.

review-hub.maxSnapshotFiles.description: Hard cap on how many files a checkpoint snapshot will read. Keeps activation cheap on very large repositories.

review-hub.autoRegisterMcp.markdownDescription: Automatically detect supported AI agents on this machine (or the current remote host) and add Review Hub MCP to their user configuration. Scans at startup, every minute and when installed extensions change. Existing MCP entries are preserved. Turning this off stops registration and keeps configurations already added.

review-hub.agents.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Include **Claude Code** when **Review Hub: Auto Register MCP** is enabled. Only detected installations are configured. Existing entries are kept when unchecked.
